_comment: Clips of the benchmark datasets that a tuning or lever-ranking set used (procedure section 4, V3). These are in-sample for ours: a report can leave them out (tools/bench/report.py --exclude-clips this file), and the site shows the view without them beside the full set. eval/tests/test_content_id.py checks that every dataset overlaps the tuning sets in exactly these clips. Added 2026-11-27 (benchmark integrity audit findings 1 and 2).

vc1k_worst6.how: lever-ranking sets: each codec's six worst VC-1K clips against a reference, picked from the VC-1K Fixed QP sample after its results were charted (vc1k-worst6-{av1,av2,hevc,vp9,vvc}.json in the work area; H.264's set is deleted)
vc1k_worst6.landed: HEVC TU16 heuristic off; HEVC deblocking +2/+2 (carried to other codecs); the moving-camera key; the RD final decision stage
vc1k_worst6.evidence: docs/analysis/benchmark-integrity-audit-2026-11-27.md finding 1; docs/handoff/rd-depth.md; docs/analysis/port-hevc-wins-2026-11-19.md; CHANGELOG.md (VC-1K six worst clips)

standards_lens.how: the standards lens: the AOM-CTC low-delay classes A3-A5 used to develop and justify our presets (docs/results/standards-ctc-2026-11-14/sources.json, whose 1280x720 '_E' variants are the same contents)
standards_lens.landed: preset choices citing lens results (presets/av1/{veryfast,faster,fast}.toml; refs.second); the frozen build still cites the lens (crates/nc-av1/src/backend.rs)
